description: merge-to-main.sh uses `git rebase origin/main` without first fetching the remote, so the rebase may operate on a stale base ref when the branch has diverged since the last fetch.
defense_text: Added `git fetch origin main` guard before the rebase in commit abc1234. The remote ref is always current at rebase time.
